about_the_game:
A lot of strange and bizarre things have happened recently in the pig farm: faucets bleeding, alarm clocks with heads growing out of them, human skins knocking on the doors...

Monsters launch attacks again and again. You will play as a weak security guard. While escaping from the pursuit of the monsters, you need to investigate the reasons for their appearance. During this period, you can use the computer monitoring to defend your position and obtain props with magical functions:

Drone, which allows you to freely switch between the first-person and third-person perspectives

Lighter, an indispensable prop for exploration at night

Make friends who can be regarded as sworn friends through thick and thin

With the help of your friends, you will come to the Mountain Park, find out the truth of the matter, defeat the real mastermind behind the scenes, and become the support for people all over the world. After purchasing this game, you will experience the double excitement brought by horror games and action games. The enemies have different defense methods. Use the magical props to deal with the unknown monsters.

highlighted.name: The wheels of history never stop.
If the last slice of pizza can fill you up, why bother with the others?
The five notes cause people to be deaf.
Even pigs can fly when they are in the wind.
It's like fishing for the moon in the water, all in vain.

content_descriptors.notes:
This is a horror puzzle-solving game, which may feature sudden scares from monsters, a dark and gloomy atmosphere, and the sense of loneliness in liminal spaces. Once you unlock the third-person perspective and obtain weapons, you can fight back against the monsters' attacks, and there will be violence in terms of actions.
Monsters may be scantily dressed for reasons related to the plot, such as zombies.

short_description: A Chinese indie game with free - level - choosing feature. In Defense mode, use computer monitoring to select the right defense when enemies approach. In Action mode, open third - person view after getting the drone, rush out of the monitoring room and defeat all enemies.
